page_title: RAY 0-0 RMA | Rayo Vallecano v Real Madrid 09/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the corner.
90+4' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
90+2' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) trips an opposition player and Juan Martinez signals a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
89' Real Madrid take a short corner kick.
87' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
86' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
85' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Juan Martinez blows his whistle for an infringement.
83' Substitution. Unai Lopez leaves the pitch and is replaced by Gerard Gumbau (Rayo Vallecano).
83' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change. Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) replaces Raul Asencio.
83' Here comes a substitution. Alemao (Rayo Vallecano) is brought on as a substitute for Alvaro Garcia.
82' Foul! Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. There is a free kick near the sideline to Real Madrid.
80' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Real Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
79' It is time for a substitution. Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is on for Eduardo Camavinga.
77' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
75' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) sends the corner into the box, but Thibaut Courtois intercepts it and averts the threat.
75' Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.
73' The attendance is 14468.
71' It will be a substitution. Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) is ready to enter the pitch as Brahim Diaz walks off.
71' Inigo Perez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Jorge de Frutos.
71' Isi Palazon comes off the pitch to be replaced by Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano).

70' A rebound falls to Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) who knows what to do with it. He drills a low shot from the edge of the penalty box, but Augusto Batalla anticipates his intention and denies him with a nice quick save.
68' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rayo Vallecano.
67' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
65' Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
64' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Juan Martinez who sees an offensive foul.
63' The corner from Arda Guler (Real Madrid) is intercepted by the defence.
62' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) strikes the ball towards goal from distance, but it goes over the bar.
61' Wow, what an escape. Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
60' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
58' 49:51 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
56' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Madrid comes to nothing.

55' The ball is crossed into the box and Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the middle of the goal, but Augusto Batalla gets a glove on it to thwart him. Real Madrid force a corner. They send men into the box.
55' Juan Martinez has a clear sight and sees a foul from Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid).
53' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
52' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Arda Guler (Real Madrid), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
51' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
50' A lofted cross from Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
48' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) produces a shot from a long-range free kick, but it flies high over the crossbar.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Xabi Alonso probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid). He is replaced by Eder Militao.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' Juan Martinez blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Juan Martinez shows a yellow card to Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
45+2' Some patient build-up play from Rayo Vallecano as they look to unlock the defence.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Rayo Vallecano, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
44' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) has tested the patience of referee Juan Martinez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
43' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
42' Corner kicks – 2:2.
39' Nobel Mendy (Rayo Vallecano) rises above the defence to meet the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches over the bar.
39' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
38' Rayo Vallecano keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
36' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) was quite harsh and Juan Martinez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
35' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
33' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
33' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
30' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:3.
27' Pedro Diaz goes off the pitch and Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) comes on.
26' Pedro Diaz (Rayo Vallecano) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
24' A precise cross towards the penalty spot was latched onto by Raul Asencio (Real Madrid). He outjumped the defence and produced a decent header which went a whisker wide of the left post.
23' The resulting corner from Arda Guler (Real Madrid) is cleared by the defence.
23' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
22' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid).

21' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) gets inside the box and tries to beat Thibaut Courtois with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
19' The ball possession is 53:47.
17' Real Madrid are ruled offside.
15' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Martinez had an easy-decision to make.
14' The resulting set piece from Rayo Vallecano is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
14' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
12' Juan Martinez interrupts the game. One of the players from Rayo Vallecano won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
10' Real Madrid are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception.
8' Augusto Batalla displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
7' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall.

5' Dean Huijsen (Real Madrid) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Juan Martinez stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Rayo Vallecano earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
5' Rayo Vallecano keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.

3' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Augusto Batalla, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
1' The match has just started.
Real Madrid will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Juan Martinez.
